name: Minazuki Kotoko
source: Best friend of Hikari Hinomoto. A strong defender of Japanese culture who hates Western influences. Usually cool-tempered, she can have explosive fits of anger towards people who annoy or irritate her. Very protective of Hikari, she doesn't think highly of the protagonist, but she's willing to help Hikari getting closer to him.
